purpose: Teach: 人脈/吟味/分岐/社交/やり直し/斬新/持ち帰り/ごまかし

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期、人脈を活かす案件を増やせ。
lines.en: This quarter, I want to see more deals that leverage existing networks.
lines.style: Direct, measured delivery. Authoritative opening — no wasted words. Even pacing, slight emphasis on 'networks.' The tone of someone stating strategy, not negotiating it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各提案、慎重に吟味します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll examine each proposal carefully.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment, steady voice. Professional assurance without flatness. Slight nod in the rhythm — showing he's not just hearing, he's committing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 戦略の分岐点、見極めろ。
lines.en: And learn to read the strategic inflection points.
lines.style: Sharpened tone. Precision-cut phrasing. Not a request — a calibration. Pause before 'inflection points' — this is where it matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 役員の社交シーンでも、関係構築を進めます。
lines.en: I'll work on building those connections even at executive social events.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate. Each phrase carries weight. Not breathless — measured like he's confirming a difficult expansion of his scope. Professional, slightly lifted at the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 失敗案件、やり直し検討。斬新な企画、優先しろ。
lines.en: On failed deals, we should explore if they're salvageable. And prioritize the genuinely innovative proposals.
lines.style: Two-part directive, cleanly separated. First part analytical, second part with slight emphasis on 'genuinely' — cutting through noise. Authoritative without aggression.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料、社外への持ち帰り厳禁です。
lines.en: Understood. All materials stay in-house — nothing leaves the office.
lines.style: Firm, non-negotiable finality. No hesitation. Professional boundary stated as fact, not caution. The clarity of someone securing something important.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ごまかしの利かない時代だ。
lines.en: We're in an era where cutting corners gets exposed immediately.
lines.style: Quiet gravitas. Slow, deliberate pacing. The close of a conversation that assumes he's been understood. A final principle, not a threat — delivered with the weight of someone who's seen consequences.
